review_goal: Assess the downstream request-context refactor for production safety.

directions.prompt: Trace errors, timeouts, retries, cancellation, concurrency, and resource lifecycle across the changed path.

findings.title: Preserve the caller context when adding the timeout
findings.body: Whenever the caller cancels the request, has an earlier deadline, or supplies request-scoped values, deriving from `context.Background()` severs that context chain. `client.Do` can therefore continue for up to two seconds after cancellation and loses metadata such as tracing or authentication; derive the timeout from the supplied `ctx` instead.
